scope: Commission setup, existing request/profile recovery and selected-course approval submission
findings: Existing requests pin an immutable issuer profile; saving settings alone cannot update them.
Issuer errors scrolled to readiness instead of opening the responsible composition.
Submission failures stayed visible after input/profile changes; the generic correlation-code error obscured the blocked action.
Selected courses were lost during settings navigation.
SUPER_ADMIN was missing from the presentation-only request action list.
implemented: Three labeled commission slots, field error focus, explicit save and return-to-request flow.
Explicit adoption of saved profile for request or independently pinned event; no automatic reassignment.
Significant commission names required by authoritative BiOT validation.
Actionable submission feedback bound to current input/selection; technical diagnostics collapsed.
Same-request session selection preserved through settings navigation; no automatic transfer after repair.
Draft preview remains available while incomplete required data blocks transfer/issuance.
Pending/approved matching scope shown as already submitted; response loss requires state recovery.
Refresh saves local edits before replacing the draft; post-save revision mismatch prevents unseen concurrent data from being submitted.
